title: rosa spinosissima var. ciliosa
intro: Rosa spinosissima var. ciliosa, commonly known as the Pink Spiny Rose, is a prickly shrub-like plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa spinosissima var. ciliosa include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
